text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa~~! That was so fire~~!! It was the 
absolute best idol festival ever...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'm tearing up, seriously. An Umadol 
mega-gathering at an amusement park... 
Whoever planned this is an absolute 
genius...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my stomach... I've barely eaten 
anything lately because I was practicing 
waving penlights. I really gotta eat 
something...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what!? Th-That insanely gorgeous 
figure over there is...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Guh-whoa! She talked to me! She knows who 
I am!? Eeeeeek!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Did you come to watch my guerrilla public 
photoshoot too, by any chance?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The announcement only went out a moment 
ago... I can't believe the fans showed up 
this fast.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...When the agency told me about the 
guerrilla gig, I honestly thought, 'For 
real?!'... But I've gotta give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, gotta go, my manager's waiting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...W-H-A-A-A-T!?!? Wait wait wait, this is 
total information overload!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaahhh~~~! Now's not the time to be 
eating!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Agnes Digital enjoyed some 
unexpected stan activities. Rumor has it 
she lost a ton of weight due to all the 
sheer excitement...
